statement.html: The vertices \(V\) of a centrally symmetric hexagon in the complex plane are given by \[ V=\left\{\begin{gathered} \sqrt2 i,\;-\sqrt2 i, \\ \tfrac{1}{\sqrt8}(1+i), \\ \tfrac{1}{\sqrt8}(-1+i), \\ \tfrac{1}{\sqrt8}(1-i), \\ \tfrac{1}{\sqrt8}(-1-i) \end{gathered}\right\}. \] For each \(j,\) \(1\le j\le12,\) an element \(z_j\) is chosen from \(V\) at random, independently of the other choices. Let \(P=\prod_{j=1}^{12}z_j\) be the product of the \(12\) numbers selected. What is the probability that \(P=-1?\)
